lastCompletedStory.title: CLI surface: parse cam issue list, route in dispatchIssue, help text

nextStoryContext: cam issue list [--all] is now a fully wired CLI subcommand: parseIssueArgs (index.ts) checks args[0] === 'list' as its OWN branch (scanning the rest for --all, rejecting any other extra arg) BEFORE the --file-local check and the free-text fallthrough, returning { mode: 'list'; all: boolean; help: false }. dispatchIssue routes mode:'list' via an injectable deps.issueListFn (IssueDispatchDeps), defaulting to `async () => runIssueList({ cwd: process.cwd(), all: parsed.all })` (import added: `import { runIssueList } from './src/commands/issue-list.ts'`). ISSUE_HELP now documents `list [--all]` in both usage and the Arguments/Behaviour sections. US-004 (orchestrator boot prompt + persona) should now instruct the orchestrator to run the literal CLI command `cam issue list` (a real shell-out, not an in-process TS call) to derive its backlog, with an explicit fallback to reading scripts/cam/issues/*.json filtered by stage when the command is unavailable or exits non-zero (covers the pre-rebuild-binary boundary: an already-installed cam binary predates this story until the operator rebuilds). runIssueList's own signature/behavior (src/commands/issue-list.ts, from US-002) is unchanged by US-003: `RunIssueListOptions = { cwd, configPath?, spawnFn?, writer?, all? } -> number`, backend-branches on issue_system ('none' reads via readBacklogFromMain + deriveBacklogView; 'linear'/'github' print a short hint). US-004 does not need to touch index.ts, parseIssueArgs, dispatchIssue, or issue-list.ts at all -- it only touches the boot-prompt builder (src/commands/run.ts buildOrchestratorBootPrompt) and the orchestrator/cam-issue persona docs (.claude/agents + templates/agents, .claude/commands + templates/commands), per CAM-123 dual-copy diff-before-edit discipline.
